status_reason: SiliconForest runs on one J293 from a hand-made install. This installer does not exist yet and has not run on any Mac, so the acceptance gates below are all not-run.

gated_majors.reason: macOS 27 is a required target. An APFS container resize failure (-69606) was reported on an M1 Pro running 27.0.1, so release builds refuse it until a real shrink passes on T8103.

personalized_fields.@SF_FSUUID@: The release's root filesystem UUID. A per-release constant, never changed at install.
personalized_fields.@SF_PARTUUID@: This Mac's root partition UUID, lower case.
personalized_fields.@SF_PART_LBA@: First 4096-byte block of the root partition.
personalized_fields.@SF_PART_BLOCKS@: Length of the root partition in 4096-byte blocks.

notes: Taken from integrations/siliconforest/m1-native-boot/install/build.sh (ARGS), the command line of the installed M1. A release's bootargs.template is authoritative and must equal this list.
The list still contains development flags (-v, debug, keepsyms, serial). Review them before a public release.

power_button.hold_copy: Press and hold the Touch ID button, at the top right of the keyboard, until you see "Loading startup options".

kernel_extensions.purpose: Platform expert (native-boot build, cores held by the loader)

kernel_extensions.name: IOGOPFramebuffer
kernel_extensions.purpose: Console framebuffer and return to text console

kernel_extensions.name: IOHIDFamily
kernel_extensions.purpose: HID family with the native input changes

items.status: Output names are expected from the extractor's rules. Not yet produced by the installer.
Output name is the one the driver loads. Extraction from this image is not yet verified.

not_installed.reason: No SiliconForest driver consumes it yet (SF-J). Add brcm/brcmbt4378b1-apple,honshu-* when one does.
No driver in this tree loads a tpmtfw file on J293.
GPU, display, sound and other coprocessor firmware is loaded by iBoot from the stub, so it comes from the 13.5 restore image and is not copied into the root.

quirks.summary: The stub is macOS 13.5. The GPU driver's pinned reference profile is V13_5/G13; the ABI of the firmware actually loaded under Darwin has not been independently proved.
quirks.effect: Never change stub.version without re-proving the GPU, display and other firmware-dependent drivers.

quirks.summary: An Omarchy install on J293 with macOS 26.6.1 and the 13.5 stub reportedly boot-loops after the recovery step. Cause unknown.
quirks.effect: Our hand-made install has started on this board with system firmware from the 20457 family, while the report is on 18000.161.9, so check each firmware family. The one-shot first boot limits the damage.

quirks.summary: bless can fail with Code 112 on M1 and M2 Macs running macOS 26.x. Cause not established.
quirks.effect: Show this specific failure with its known options. Do not call it a wrong password.

quirks.summary: Stage 1 refuses a stage 2 whose span overlaps its live heap. Only its own image size, 4,325,376 bytes, is certain.
quirks.effect: Fail the install before writing if the stage 2 span plus margin exceeds the budget.

quirks.summary: SiliconForest cannot change the default boot volume.
quirks.effect: Boot selection must be set from macOS or recoveryOS. A failed start must be able to land in macOS.

quirks.summary: The kernel writes only inside the root partition named on its command line.
quirks.effect: sf/kernel.bin must be personalised after the root partition exists, and the boot receipt must live inside the root partition.

quirks.summary: The development M1's layout was made by hand, with its root before the stub.
quirks.effect: Classified as sf.unproven. The installer refuses to modify or remove it.
